data.name: Sapna
data.gender_notes: Sapna is used as a unisex name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: A name derived from the Sanskrit word 'Sapna', meaning 'dream' or 'vision'. In Hindu mythology, 'Sapna' is believed to be the goddess of dreams, who appears in our dreams to guide us and reveal our inner desires and aspirations. She is also associated with the night sky, the moon, and the stars. The name Sapna carries the meaning “Dream, Vision” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Sapna usually hope their child will grow to embody dream, vision and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Symbolizes the power of the subconscious mind to shape our reality through our dreams and visions.
data.etymology: Sapna belongs to the Sanskrit linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Dream, Vision.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Sapna total 6, giving a life-path number of 6. Number 6 is linked with Venus and with the qualities of responsibility, care and community.
